cards.situation: I left the coffee shop shift at 2 pm to catch a train.
cards.action: I just told my coworker that everything was fine.
cards.result: She did not know the milk order was not placed and we ran out the next morning.
cards.lesson: When handing work to someone else, write down the current state and the next step before leaving.

cards.situation: I moved off a half-finished feature branch to fix an urgent bug.
cards.action: I did not leave any notes.
cards.result: When a teammate took over, she spent a day working out what was missing.
cards.lesson: Before passing something on unfinished, leave a short note on where you stopped and what comes next.

cards.situation: I went on holiday for two weeks and asked a friend to water my balcony plants.
cards.action: I said to water them when dry.
cards.result: She watered daily and the succulents rotted, while the ferns she thought were fine died.
cards.lesson: When someone else takes over a task, tell them the specifics of each item, not a general rule.

cards.situation: I cut my own hair with clippers before an interview.
cards.action: I skipped using a guard on the sides.
cards.result: It came out much shorter than I wanted.
cards.lesson: When using a tool you cannot undo, start with the gentlest setting.

cards.situation: I opened a credit card for the sign-up bonus.
cards.action: I did not check the annual fee.
cards.result: I was charged 95 dollars the next year.
cards.lesson: When signing up for a deal, read the recurring costs before the benefits.

cards.situation: I bought a monthly gym pass and meant to go five days a week.
cards.action: I set no schedule.
cards.result: I went three times in a month.
cards.lesson: When starting a habit, fix the days and times in the calendar first.

cards.situation: 周五下午的评审会，要大家对一份 40 页的方案表态。
cards.action: 会前没发材料，会上现场翻页讲。
cards.result: 没人敢表态，会议白开了。
cards.lesson: 需要对方当场做判断时，提前把材料发给对方。

cards.situation: 给高二学生上物理公开课，要讲电磁感应。
cards.action: 开课前没让学生预习，现场就开始推公式。
cards.result: 学生一脸茫然，只有前排两个人跟上了。
cards.lesson: 希望对方在现场能有判断或理解，就在现场之前把基础材料送到他们手里。

cards.situation: 我给阳台种的葡萄剪枝。
cards.action: 在夏天剪，剪得很重。
cards.result: 当年一串也没结。
cards.lesson: 修剪要看季节，不对时间的重剪会伤到结果的枝。

cards.situation: 买一台二手相机。
cards.action: 只看了成色。
cards.result: 回家发现快门次数已经 18 万。
cards.lesson: 买旧货先问关键损耗数据，成色不能代替它。

cards.situation: 家里的窗户漏风，我买了一卷密封条。
cards.action: 没擦窗框就直接贴。
cards.result: 一周后全掉了。
cards.lesson: 粘贴类的工作，先清理表面再下手。

cards.situation: 公司数据库每晚自动备份，我一直以为很安全。
cards.action: 某次硬盘坏了，才第一次尝试恢复。
cards.result: 发现备份文件是空的，丢了两周的订单。
cards.lesson: 依赖某份备份时，先真的恢复一次，确认能用再放心。

cards.situation: 做口味很重的红烧肉，糖色炒得很快。
cards.action: 一直开大火不停翻动。
cards.result: 糖焦了发苦。
cards.lesson: 需要火候精确的步骤，全程守在旁边，用小火慢来。

cards.situation: 手机照片开了云同步，我以为都存上了。
cards.action: 换新手机时才去下载。
cards.result: 发现云端只同步了最近的 2000 张，旧照片没了。
cards.lesson: 依赖某份备份时，先真的恢复一次，确认能用再放心。

cards.situation: 拍婚礼的录像素材，素材拷在一块移动硬盘里。
cards.action: 从没有插到别的电脑上试过读取。
cards.result: 交付前硬盘不被识别，只救回了一半。
cards.lesson: 要靠它救命的副本，必须在出事之前实际用一次，证明它能还原。

cards.situation: 报税季整理发票。
cards.action: 全都塞进一个信封。
cards.result: 找一张餐费发票花了两小时。
cards.lesson: 票据一收到就按月份归好，不要攒到最后。

cards.situation: 租房时房东口头说押金退还没问题，墙面有些划痕他不在意。
cards.action: 没有留任何文字记录。
cards.result: 退租时他扣了 1500 块，说划痕要赔。
cards.lesson: 口头说定的事，当天用文字发给对方确认。

cards.situation: 项目里我和同事在走廊说好，他负责对接接口文档，我写前端。
cards.action: 没有写进任务表。
cards.result: 两周后互相以为对方在做，文档没人写。
cards.lesson: 当面谈妥的分工，立即发一条消息复述一遍，留下可查的记录。

cards.situation: 做咖啡拉花，我连续练了很多次。
cards.action: 每次都用冷牛奶。
cards.result: 奶泡太粗，怎么倒都没有纹路。
cards.lesson: 练一个动作之前，先确认材料的状态是对的，不然白练。

cards.situation: 我想做一个自己的小站。
cards.action: 先花了两周挑模板配色。
cards.result: 内容一篇没写。
cards.lesson: 先把最核心的东西做出来，外观最后再调。

cards.situation: 冬天给院里的月季施肥。
cards.action: 施了浓肥。
cards.result: 根被烧伤，春天只发了几个芽。
cards.lesson: 肥宜淡不宜浓，宁可少量多次。

cards.situation: 带父母去体检。
cards.action: 没提前问清要不要空腹。
cards.result: 早饭吃了，抽血只好改天。
cards.lesson: 带别人出门办事前，把对方要做的准备问清楚。

cards.situation: I wrote a cover letter and sent the same one to 15 jobs.
cards.action: I only changed the company name.
cards.result: I got zero replies in three weeks.
cards.lesson: When applying for something competitive, tailor the first paragraph to the specific recipient.

cards.situation: I made a risotto in a thin pan.
cards.action: I added all the stock at once.
cards.result: It turned into soup.
cards.lesson: When a dish depends on gradual absorption, add liquid a little at a time.

cards.situation: I installed a software update an hour before a live demo.
cards.action: I did not test afterward.
cards.result: The projector would not connect and we lost ten minutes.
cards.lesson: When something must work at a set time, freeze changes the day before.

cards.situation: I tutored a student in algebra and gave the answer when he hesitated.
cards.action: I did it five times in a session.
cards.result: He learned to wait for me to answer.
cards.lesson: When someone is learning, wait through the silence a little longer before helping.

cards.situation: I hung a heavy mirror with two small nails.
cards.action: I guessed the weight.
cards.result: It fell during the night and cracked.
cards.lesson: When hanging something heavy, find the wall studs and weigh the object first.

cards.situation: I planned a three-city trip in five days in Italy.
cards.action: I booked every night in a different hotel.
cards.result: I spent most of the trip packing and unpacking.
cards.lesson: When planning travel, limit the number of bases rather than the number of sights.

cards.situation: 和客户通电话，我讲得很快，想早点结束。
cards.action: 没有复述确认需求。
cards.result: 客户要的是蓝色版本，我记成了绿色。
cards.lesson: 通话结束前把对方的要求复述一遍。

cards.situation: 做蛋挞皮，黄油软化过头。
cards.action: 硬是继续擀。
cards.result: 面团粘在案板上，皮全是油。
cards.lesson: 面团太软时先放冰箱回凉再做，不要硬撑。

cards.situation: 在深圳住短租，没看房子楼层。
cards.action: 到了发现是七楼没电梯。
cards.result: 拖着两个箱子爬上去。
cards.lesson: 订房前确认楼层和电梯，尤其是带大件行李时。

cards.situation: 早上六点跑步，天还没亮。
cards.action: 穿了深色衣服在路边跑。
cards.result: 被一辆电动车差点撞到。
cards.lesson: 夜间或清晨在路上运动时穿亮色并带反光物。

cards.situation: 我做一个文档管理的小脚本。
cards.action: 直接对原目录运行，没有先在副本上试。
cards.result: 文件被重命名错了 200 个。
cards.lesson: 批量处理文件之前，先在副本上跑一遍。

cards.situation: 组织一次同学聚会，群里问大家哪天方便。
cards.action: 开放式问了日期。
cards.result: 一周没有结论。
cards.lesson: 约时间时给出两三个具体选项让对方选，不要问开放式问题。

cards.situation: 红薯放在冰箱里保存。
cards.action: 放了十天。
cards.result: 硬心、不好吃。
cards.lesson: 怕冷的食材不要放冰箱，看清适合的保存温度。

cards.situation: 给老人买手机，我选了功能最全的。
cards.action: 没让他试用。
cards.result: 他觉得太复杂，一直不用。
cards.lesson: 替别人挑工具，让他先上手试一下再定。

cards.situation: 用 Python 读一个大 CSV。
cards.action: 一次性读进内存，文件有 8GB。
cards.result: 程序被系统杀掉。
cards.lesson: 处理大文件时先看大小，分块读取。

cards.situation: 买了一个昂贵的焊台想学电子。
cards.action: 没有基础也没有练习件。
cards.result: 第一次就烧坏一块开发板。
cards.lesson: 学一项新手艺，先用便宜的废件练手。

cards.situation: 想借朋友的钱周转 2000 块。
cards.action: 只说了借，没说什么时候还。
cards.result: 两个人都不好意思再提。
cards.lesson: 借钱时一开始就说好还款的日期。

cards.situation: 做 PPT 时每一页都放满了字。
cards.action: 在台上照着念。
cards.result: 听众很快就没在听了。
cards.lesson: 一页只放一个意思，字少图大。

cards.situation: 给孩子辅导英语单词，一次背 50 个。
cards.action: 当天考了一遍。
cards.result: 第二天几乎全忘了。
cards.lesson: 背记类的内容分次间隔复习，一次不要太多。

cards.situation: 用电钻在水泥墙上打孔，位置凭眼睛估。
cards.action: 直接打了。
cards.result: 孔位偏了一厘米，挂画歪了。
cards.lesson: 打孔前先用铅笔画好十字并量一遍。

cards.situation: 周末骑行，路上突然下雨。
cards.action: 没带雨衣，硬骑回去。
cards.result: 感冒了三天。
cards.lesson: 骑行出门前查天气预报并带上一件防风防雨的外套。

cards.situation: 为了省钱，买了一台最便宜的显示器。
cards.action: 每天对着看八小时。
cards.result: 眼睛酸痛，两个月后换了新的。
cards.lesson: 每天长时间用的东西不要在舒适度上省钱。

cards.situation: I booked a flight to Lisbon with a 55-minute connection in Frankfurt.
cards.action: I picked it because it was 90 euros cheaper.
cards.result: The first leg was 40 minutes late and I missed the second, losing a night's hotel.
cards.lesson: When a plan has a connection with under 90 minutes of buffer, book the later option.

cards.situation: I started a spreadsheet of household expenses in January.
cards.action: I categorized each item by hand with long free-text labels.
cards.result: By March I could not sum anything because the labels never matched.
cards.lesson: When recording data you will total later, use a fixed list of categories from day one.

cards.situation: My landlord and I agreed on the phone to fix the heater by Friday.
cards.action: I did not write it down.
cards.result: He later said he had never promised a date.
cards.lesson: When something is agreed by voice, send a written summary the same day.

cards.situation: I taught a 90-minute workshop on pivot tables.
cards.action: I showed every feature in turn.
cards.result: People remembered nothing a week later.
cards.lesson: When teaching, give people one task to finish themselves rather than a tour of features.

cards.situation: I tried to patch a drywall hole with filler in one thick coat.
cards.action: I let it dry overnight.
cards.result: It cracked and shrank, and I redid it.
cards.lesson: When filling a gap, build up in thin layers and let each one dry.

cards.situation: I ran my first 10K after skipping all easy runs and doing only hard ones.
cards.action: I kept the same hard pace every session.
cards.result: I hit a wall at 6K and walked the rest.
cards.lesson: When training for an event, mix easy sessions in rather than running everything hard.

cards.situation: 合并销售表和客户表，用客户名作为连接键。
cards.action: 合并后直接做了汇总。
cards.result: 总销售额比财务的数多了 12%，原来有重名客户导致重复行。
cards.lesson: 合并两份数据后，先核对行数和重复项，再往下分析。

cards.situation: 想存钱，每月月底把剩下的钱存起来。
cards.action: 月底常常不剩。
cards.result: 半年只存了 800 块。
cards.lesson: 想存的钱发薪当天就转走，剩下的才是能花的。

cards.situation: 晒被子时顺手把枕头也放到阳台。
cards.action: 傍晚才想起来，下雨了。
cards.result: 枕头湿透了。
cards.lesson: 把东西放到外面时，同时给自己定一个收回的闹钟。

cards.situation: 教学生写作文，我把每处错误都用红笔改了。
cards.action: 发还作业。
cards.result: 学生只看了分数，下次错误照旧。
cards.lesson: 批改时只标最关键的两三处，让对方自己去改。

cards.situation: 家里的灯泡接触不良，我换了灯泡。
cards.action: 没有检查灯座。
cards.result: 新灯泡一周后又闪。
cards.lesson: 换掉零件后问题还在，就说明原因在别处，转去查相邻的部分。

cards.situation: 厨房水龙头滴水，我自己拆换阀芯。
cards.action: 没有关角阀就直接拧开了。
cards.result: 水喷了一屋，地板泡了，修了两天。
cards.lesson: 动手拆之前，先切断源头。

cards.situation: 读书会上，我准备了很详细的发言稿。
cards.action: 照着稿子念了 20 分钟。
cards.result: 大家都低头看手机。
cards.lesson: 面对面的分享，用要点而不是整稿，眼睛要看着人。

cards.situation: 给朋友的婚礼做伴奏，只练了一遍就上了。
cards.action: 没有和他们合过流程。
cards.result: 进场的时间点差了八拍。
cards.lesson: 和别人配合的演出，至少合一遍完整流程再上场。

cards.situation: 在网上订酒店，看到价格很低。
cards.action: 没看取消政策就付款了。
cards.result: 航班改期后订金一分钱没退。
cards.lesson: 付款前先看清退改条款，价格不是唯一标准。

cards.situation: 给多肉换盆，用了普通的园土。
cards.action: 浇水和平时一样。
cards.result: 根部积水，两周后烂了。
cards.lesson: 换了介质，浇水的节奏也要跟着调整。

cards.situation: 整理 3 年的照片，直接删了看着模糊的。
cards.action: 没有先备份就批量删除。
cards.result: 误删了一批孩子满月的照片。
cards.lesson: 批量删除之前，先把整个目录复制到别处。

cards.situation: 感冒休息了两周，回到健身房。
cards.action: 直接按停之前的重量做深蹲，140 公斤。
cards.result: 腰拉伤，又歇了三周。
cards.lesson: 中断一段时间后恢复时，从原来的六成开始。

cards.situation: 周会上大家讨论了一个小时没有结论。
cards.action: 我一直没发言。
cards.result: 会后任务被分到了我头上，我根本不同意。
cards.lesson: 对结论有保留时，在会上当场说，不要留到会后。

cards.situation: 用 Excel 做月度支出表，把所有项目都写在一列。
cards.action: 每月复制一份新表。
cards.result: 年底想汇总时发现格式都对不上。
cards.lesson: 需要长期累积的记录，一开始就用统一的格式和固定的列。

cards.situation: 腌了一罐泡菜，每天都打开闻一闻。
cards.action: 频繁开盖。
cards.result: 第五天长了白膜。
cards.lesson: 发酵类的东西少打扰，按时间表检查，不要频繁开盖。

cards.situation: 去爬山，鞋子是新买的。
cards.action: 没有磨合就穿着走了 12 公里。
cards.result: 两个脚后跟全是水泡。
cards.lesson: 重要的行程前，新装备先在短途里用过。

cards.situation: I replied to an email about a colleague's performance.
cards.action: I hit reply-all without checking the recipients.
cards.result: The whole department saw it.
cards.lesson: Before sending anything sensitive, read the recipients line out loud.

cards.situation: A project email thread reached 40 messages over two weeks.
cards.action: I asked the new person to read the whole thread.
cards.result: She skimmed it and missed the final decision.
cards.lesson: When a discussion has gone long, restate the decision in a fresh short message.

cards.situation: I pruned my apple tree in May.
cards.action: I cut off a third of the branches.
cards.result: The tree gave almost no fruit that year.
cards.lesson: When trimming a living thing, remove only a little at a time and in the right season.

cards.situation: I signed up for a half marathon with no plan.
cards.action: I ran when I felt like it.
cards.result: I finished in pain, 20 minutes slower than my goal.
cards.lesson: When aiming at a date, work back to a weekly plan.

cards.situation: I bought a cheap ladder for roof work.
cards.action: I did not test it on level ground.
cards.result: One leg sank into soft soil and I fell 2 meters.
cards.lesson: When working at height, test your support on firm ground first.

cards.situation: I assembled a bunk bed from a kit.
cards.action: I threw away the small bags of bolts to tidy up.
cards.result: I could not fix a loose rail a month later.
cards.lesson: When keeping spare parts is cheap, keep them until the job has proven itself.

cards.situation: 用 git 合并分支遇到冲突，很多文件冲突，我很烦躁。
cards.action: 直接 git reset --hard 想回到干净状态。
cards.result: 本地未提交的改动全丢了，只救回一部分。
cards.lesson: 做有破坏性的操作之前，先建一个备份分支或存下当前状态。

cards.situation: 用 git 提交代码，我的提交说明常常只写 fix。
cards.action: 连续提交了三十多次都是这样。
cards.result: 半年后查一个回归问题，完全看不出哪次提交改了什么。
cards.lesson: 留给未来的说明要写原因，不只写动作。

cards.situation: 在新家种了一株柠檬树。
cards.action: 放在朝北的阳台。
cards.result: 一年没开花。
cards.lesson: 需要强光的植物，放朝南或有直射光的位置。

cards.situation: 报名了一个线上英语班。
cards.action: 买了一年的课。
cards.result: 三周后就没上了。
cards.lesson: 长期课程先买短期体验，确认能坚持再买长的。

cards.situation: 给朋友修电脑，重装系统。
cards.action: 没有先问他有没有重要文件。
cards.result: 他的论文草稿没了。
cards.lesson: 动别人的东西之前，先问清楚哪些不能丢。

cards.situation: 刚给吉他换了一套新琴弦。
cards.action: 调好音就开始弹。
cards.result: 半小时内音一直往下掉。
cards.lesson: 新换的弦先拉伸几遍，再调音。

cards.situation: 练一首快歌，我一开始就按原速弹。
cards.action: 弹错就继续往下赶。
cards.result: 错误的指法被固定下来。
cards.lesson: 先用慢速加节拍器练准，再逐步提速。

cards.situation: 和同事一起出差。
cards.action: 订了离会场很远但便宜的酒店。
cards.result: 每天通勤三小时，状态很差。
cards.lesson: 订住宿时把通勤时间折算进成本。

cards.situation: 我想自己做一个网站。
cards.action: 一开始就选了最复杂的框架。
cards.result: 光配置就花了两周。
cards.lesson: 选工具以够用为准，复杂的等需要时再换。

cards.situation: 给家里的猫喂新猫粮。
cards.action: 一次全换。
cards.result: 猫拉肚子三天。
cards.lesson: 换食物要用七天逐步掺。

cards.situation: 炖红烧排骨时，我一开始就加了很多盐。
cards.action: 小火炖了两小时。
cards.result: 肉发柴，味道也偏咸。
cards.lesson: 调味要分次加，最后阶段再定咸淡。

cards.situation: 腌黄瓜，我凭手感撒盐。
cards.action: 没有称重。
cards.result: 第一罐太咸，第二罐太淡长了霉。
cards.lesson: 需要比例准确的配方，用秤称，不凭手感。

cards.situation: 早上出门前赶着，我把手机放在了床上。
cards.action: 到了公司才发现。
cards.result: 整个上午联系不上客户。
cards.lesson: 出门前固定在门口检查三件东西。

cards.situation: 写一篇投稿，开头讲了很多背景。
cards.action: 四百字之后才进入主题。
cards.result: 编辑回信说前两段可以删掉。
cards.lesson: 开头直接写读者最关心的东西，背景放后面。

cards.situation: 学习打鼓，我买了一对很重的鼓棒。
cards.action: 每天练一小时。
cards.result: 手腕酸痛，只好停了。
cards.lesson: 入门阶段选轻一点、容易控制的工具。

cards.situation: 和同事一起租车去旅游。
cards.action: 没有说好油费怎么分。
cards.result: 回来时为 80 块闹得不愉快。
cards.lesson: 涉及分钱的事先讲规则再出发。
